note: Deletion surface of each compared system, read from the distribution rather than its documentation. 'granularity' is the finest unit the API can name. 'predicate_scoped' asks whether the API can express a condition over content -- 'everything about this subject's attribute' -- without the caller first enumerating identifiers.

cognee.granularity: one data item, one dataset, or everything the user owns

operations.cognee.forget: *, data_id: Optional[UUID] = None, dataset: Optional[str] = None, dataset_id: Optional[UUID] = None, everything: bool = False, memory_only: bool = False, user: Any = None,

graphiti.granularity: one episode, i.e. one ingested turn

hindsight.granularity: not captured -- the package was not installed for this inspection

langmem.granularity: one memory key; an agent tool may also emit a delete action naming a key

mem0.granularity: one memory id, or every memory under a user/agent/run scope

operations.Memory.delete_all: (self, user_id: Optional[str] = None, agent_id: Optional[str] = None, run_id: Optional[str] = None)
